name: Translations and localization (i18n)
needs: show dates and prices the way each country expects
summary: Pulling every user-facing string out of the code into translation files, picking a language per user, and formatting dates, numbers, currencies and plurals with the locale's rules. Done early, it's cheap. Done late, it means touching every screen.
need_when: You have or want users who prefer another language.
You show dates, numbers or money to people in more than one country.
skip_when: One market, one language, no plans to change. Still use locale-aware date and number formatting.

ways.title: Your framework's i18n system
ways.how: Django gettext with .po files, Rails I18n, i18next or next-intl for React, vue-i18n, Flutter intl.
ways.tradeoff: Standard and free. You manage translation files and missing keys.

ways.title: A translation management platform
ways.how: Crowdin, Lokalise, Phrase, or open source Weblate or Tolgee sync files with your repo and give translators an editor.
ways.tradeoff: Smooth for many languages and translators. Another tool to run or pay for.

ways.title: Machine translation first, review after
ways.how: Translate new strings with an AI or translation API, then have a fluent speaker review key screens.
ways.tradeoff: Fast. Legal, billing and safety text needs human review.

prompt:
Add translations to my app, starting with [Spanish].

Requirements:
- Use [framework i18n tool]. Move every user-facing string (pages, emails, errors, notifications) into translation keys.
- Whole sentences per key with placeholders, never sentences glued from pieces. Handle plurals with the library's plural rules.
- Language choice order: user setting, then the browser's Accept-Language, then [English]. Save the choice on the account and use it for emails too.
- Format dates, numbers and money with the locale (Intl API or framework helpers). Keep storing data in UTC and plain numbers.
- Set the html lang attribute. Make layouts survive 30 percent longer text.
- Add a check that fails CI on missing keys in any language file.
- Don't translate user-generated content.

Acceptance checks (run each and show me the result):
1. Switching to Spanish changes pages, emails and error messages.
2. 1 item and 2 items use the right plural forms.
3. Dates show as 21/10/2026 for es-ES and 10/21/2026 for en-US.
4. Removing a key from the Spanish file fails CI.
5. No English strings remain on main screens in Spanish mode.
acceptance_checks: Switching to Spanish changes pages, emails and error messages.
1 item and 2 items use the right plural forms.
Dates show as 21/10/2026 for es-ES and 10/21/2026 for en-US.
Removing a key from the Spanish file fails CI.
No English strings remain on main screens in Spanish mode.
if_you_skip_it: Half-translated screens, broken grammar from glued strings, and a painful rewrite when the first non-English customer arrives.
how_derek_runs_it: Custody Journal has Django's i18n turned on with English and Spanish, the locale middleware, and a Spanish translation catalog in its locale folder.
